notablePrerequisites: Bloodspore Thrinax has at least four +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Wild Cantor by paying {R/G}.
Wild Cantor enters the battlefield, triggering Paleoloth, returning Reckless Barbarian from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing itself, adding {1}.
Cast Reckless Barbarian by paying {1}{R}.
Reckless Barbarian enters the battlefield, triggering Paleoloth, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to your hand.
